info.title: Minecraft Banking System API
info.description: Minecraft banking simulation using fictional DB currency. Amounts are exact decimal strings. Browser sessions use passwords or optional Discord OAuth2 with same-origin writes. Integration keys require scopes and account allowlists. Financial commands require stable idempotency keys.
